name: Korg NAUTILUS Wave Sequence
description: Korg NAUTILUS: a wave sequence, its common settings and 64 steps, by SysEx parameter change, read back from the current wave sequence.

sources.title: NAUTILUS MIDI Implementation: Wave Seq, object version 1
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from SysExDumps/WaveSequence.txt (sha256 fa22890ba8fce7e712d532c78a931452df6ffad41d150ed85da616e5117f67f9) in NAUTILUS_MIDIimp.zip of 2022-09-22, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/873/4923/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of SysExDumps/WaveSequence.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Wave Seq Parameter Change (function 55): F0 42 3g 00 01 5D 55 step PID and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4), the table's IDX, PID columns giving the step, PID. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Repeated blocks: Step1: 64 blocks 34 bytes apart, the table printing the first in full and the others by their first and last rows, each checked.

A wave sequence: its common settings and its 64 steps. The NAUTILUS takes wave seq parameters in Wave Seq mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"). The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values. The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.
Left out: 1 setting (Common Duration AMS Intensity): its data(hex) cell is cut short.

Left out: 64 settings (Step1 Bank Select UUID; Step2 Bank Select UUID; Step3 Bank Select UUID; Step4 Bank Select UUID; Step5 Bank Select UUID; Step6 Bank Select UUID; …): a 16-byte UUID, sent by Parameter Change (binary), function 44.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 05, the wave seq, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 1 and 2216 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 2533 bytes). 975 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A dump of any other length does not match.

Byte order: a value over whole bytes is read low byte first, and a field that runs on into the next byte has its low bits in the earlier one. The tables fill each byte from bit 0 upward (every effect's Bypass is bit 0 of its first byte, Wet/Dry bits 7~1 beside it), and a field crossing a byte continues upward in the next (an EXi engine's [LFO1] Start Phase at bits 7~5, then 3~0): the layout of a little-endian structure. A reading, not tried on an instrument.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (NAUTILUS_MIDI_MIDI_Implentaion.txt) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 00 01 5D 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7, 17 bytes where the universal reply has 15. Its 7th to 10th bytes, 00 01 5D 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family and member code; its 11th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: NAUTILUS 61Keys 05H, NAUTILUS 73Keys 0EH, NAUTILUS 88Keys 17H.
No preset recall: the implementation prints no banks for this object.
